title: Signal Modeling
description: A disclosure of how a modeled signal is built: modeling method, seed source, training data jurisdictions, and EU AI Act risk class.

training_data_jurisdictions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the model's training data was collected.
